answers.stem_only: MACsec is not an option because it is offered only on dedicated connections at higher speeds, not on a 1 Gbps hosted connection. Adding TLS to dozens of applications is high overhead. Run an IPsec Site-to-Site VPN over the Direct Connect connection (private IP VPN terminating on the transit gateway via the transit virtual interface) and route VPC traffic through its tunnels: one central change encrypts all traffic.
